title: 第9章 恶客上门第10章 颠倒黑白
lines: 江旭带领江明到来后，其余几个被江尘教训的小崽子，也带着他们的父母来到二房门外。
“江尘！
你身为已经觉醒的年长之人，怎能如此欺负你的弟弟们！
你还是人吗？”
“以前怎么没发现你竟是这样的坏种！”
“江战，今日你必须给我们一个交代！
看看你家那个小畜生把我儿子打成什么样了！”
一群人刚一到达，便立刻开始对江尘口诛笔伐。
放在觉醒之前，忌于江尘平日里的表现，以及家主表现出来的喜爱，他们是绝对不敢说什么的。
但如今，二房一窝老弱病残，已经不足为虑。
看着这些颠倒黑白的同族，常婉茹抱着江雪脸色发白，江战气得浑身发抖。
“你们，你们竟如此黑白不分！
若不是你们家的孩子欺负我女儿，尘儿岂会出手？”
江战指着江雪脸上的巴掌印，厉声说道。
这话顿时令其中几人愣了愣。
他们看到自家孩子脸上的伤后，询问了始作俑者，便连忙带着孩子前来讨要说法，还真没来得及询问前因后果。
看了一眼自家孩子，几个小崽子顿时表情不自然地低下了头。
这下还有什么不明白的。
家族之中人口众多，孩童数量也多。
发生摩擦是常有的事。
如果是他们的孩子先动手，那么还真不占理。
“二弟，不管怎么说，你家江尘也不该对自己的兄弟下手这么重！”
江旭皱着眉头，义正辞严道。
“江尘不管是不是废武魂，觉醒之后力量必然会有所增长。
而这些小辈却还未觉醒，仅仅因为一点小摩擦，便将孩子们打成这样，岂是为人兄长应该做的？”
江明也阴险地盯着江尘，嘲讽道：“江尘，要我看，你不是为了给你妹妹报仇，而是觉醒了废武魂后心情郁闷，拿我这几个弟弟们出气吧！
我弟弟虽因为那个臭丫头口出恶言一时上头打了她一巴掌，但也罪不至死啊！
何至于对他下这么重的手？
这里面若没有私心，我是绝对不信的。”
欺负你的人比你自己还知道你有多冤枉。
江浩平日里什么德行父子俩岂能不知？
content_en:
After Jiang Xu and Jiang Ming arrived, the other kids who had been taught a lesson by Jiang Chen also brought their parents to the door of the second room.
"Jiang Chen!
As an older person who has awakened, how can you bully your younger brothers like this!
Are you still human? "
"Why didn't I realize you were such a bad guy before?"
"Jiang Zhan, you must give us an explanation today!
Look what your little beast did to my son! "
As soon as a group of people arrived, they immediately began to criticize Jiang Chen.
Before awakening, they would never dare to say anything due to Jiang Chen's daily behavior and the affection shown by the family head.
But now, having two bedrooms and one home for the elderly, the weak, the sick and the disabled is no longer a concern.
Seeing these fellow tribesmen who were confusing right and wrong, Chang Wanru's face turned pale while holding Jiang Xue, and Jiang Zhan was trembling with anger.
"You, you are so indifferent to black and white!
If your children hadn't bullied my daughter, how would Chen'er have taken action? "
Jiang Zhan pointed at the slap mark on Jiang Xue's face and said sternly.
These words immediately stunned several of them.
After they saw the injuries on their children's faces, they asked the culprit and quickly brought their children to ask for an explanation. They really didn't have time to ask about the cause and effect.
After taking a look at their children, the cubs immediately lowered their heads with unnatural expressions.
There's nothing I don't understand now.
The family has a large population and a large number of children.
Friction is common.
If it was their child who made the first move, it would really be unreasonable.
"Second brother, no matter what, your Jiang Chen shouldn't be so harsh on his brother!"
Jiang Xu frowned and spoke sternly.
"Regardless of whether Jiang Chen has a useless martial soul or not, his strength will definitely increase after he awakens.
But these juniors have not yet awakened. Just because of a small friction, they beat the children like this. Is this what a brother should do? "
Jiang Ming also stared at Jiang Chen insidiously and said mockingly: "Jiang Chen, let me see, you are not trying to avenge your sister, but you are depressed after awakening the useless martial spirit, take it out on my brothers!
Even though my brother slapped that smelly girl in the face because of her bad words, his crime was not worthy of death!
Why did you deal with him so harshly?
If there is no selfishness in this, I will never believe it. "
The person who bullies you knows better than you yourself how wronged you are.
How could father and son not know Jiang Hao's daily virtues?
title_en: Chapter 9 The evil guest comes to the door Chapter 10 Confusing right and wrong
